create_new_vector_store: create a new vector store with an ID, provider, name, description, metadata, and litellm parameters
list_vector_stores: list all managed vector stores with optional pagination using page and page_size parameters
delete_vector_store: delete a vector store by its unique vector store ID
get_vector_store_info: get details of a single vector store by its vector store ID
update_vector_store: update vector store details such as name, description, metadata, or litellm params by vector store ID
